scientific_integrity: Proved self-contained structural and enumeration reductions using explicitly cited standard inversion-graph facts; no claim of independent verification or global literature completeness.
scientific_limitations: Only the highest three connectivity layers are determined for n>=4. The scalar unweighted a_n sequence is previously catalogued as shifted OEIS A180965; novelty concerns the structural connectivity identification and weighted refinement. Unindexed equivalent formulations remain a priority risk. Finite tests are not proofs of all n.
title: High-connectivity tails of inversion-graph enumerators via path–triangle complements
